'''Media''' was a branch of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence's]] [[Analysis Bureau (Imperial Intelligence)|Analysis Bureau]]. It was responsible for monitoring public [[Scandoc/Legends|scandocs]], [[newsdoc]]s, [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]], [[beamcast]]s, and other [[Media/Legends|media]] to look for hidden messages and patterns that might have been planted by enemy agents. With support from the [[Sector Plexus/Legends|Sector Plexus]] and [[Imperial CompLink]], Media was able to cursorily scan all media within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
